scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix api && npm ci --prefix mcp
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names API,WEB --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm --prefix api start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix mcp test && npm --prefix mcp run check:node-loadable
scripts.audit: npm audit --prefix frontend --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix api --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix mcp --audit-level=high
